context.body: The mountain in three witnesses · Matthew 17:1–8
context.label: Canonical location

observations.body: After six days Jesus takes three disciples up a high mountain; his face shines, his clothes become white, and Moses and Elijah appear speaking with him.
observations.label: Jesus is transfigured before Peter, James, and John: action

observations.body: Peter proposes three tents; a bright cloud overshadows them, the voice names the beloved Son and commands listening, and the frightened disciples finally see Jesus alone.
observations.label: Jesus is transfigured before Peter, James, and John: response

observations.body: after six days · face shone · Moses and Elijah · bright cloud · listen to him
observations.label: Words in Matthew 17:1–8

payload.posture: Read Matthew 17:1–8 as the mountain in three witnesses evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The text does not explain why Peter proposes tents or disclose the content of Moses and Elijah’s speech.
payload.title: Jesus is transfigured before Peter, James, and John
